feed.label: FILM FACT

slides.headline: The mechanical shark in *Jaws* (1975) kept breaking down. So the film shows it less, and got scarier.
slides.sub: Sometimes the limit is the trick.

feed.caption:
The shark did not work. So you barely see it for the first hour, and your imagination does the rest.

Sometimes the thing that goes wrong is the thing that makes it great.
